_how_to_use: Add approved reviews to the TOP of the "reviews" list, in the same shape, without "sample": true. tool must be one of: Send, Pixel, Pinky, WinXP, Marketplace. rating is 1-5. text is up to 280 characters. The rating, review count and "would recommend" figures on the site are worked out from the real reviews here. The entries marked "sample": true are made-up placeholders and are NOT shown unless you set showSamples to true (only do that for a private preview, never on the live site).
